name: 终极地狱完整版
group_note: 终极地狱完整版 (in-game banner: EMPEROR OF ULTRA HELL(BLOOD & MAGIC) FROM 2002.06.2), same Doing-lineage 'hell' family as this session's already-processed zjdy2008wzb -- shares near-identical master.lpc/logind.lpc/named.lpc structure (raw archive is literally named 'hell'). WASM pass fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese() (str[i] byte-pair check with 161/255/176/248 thresholds and i%2 parity) rewritten to per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff; check_legal_name()'s matching bounds (minimum 2->1, maxlen not halved -> maxlen/2) fixed to match. (2) master.lpc (adm/single/master.lpc) valid_read()/valid_write() missing the standard 'user == this_object()' guard -- added to both. (3) The combined surname+name minimum-length check in get_name() (strlen(fname)<4, byte-doubled) and named.lpc's invalid_new_name() sliding-window near-name dedup (minimum 2->1, window slices name[i..i+3]/name[i..i+5] -> name[i..i+1]/name[i..i+2], loop bound l-4 -> l-2, gate i+6<=l -> i+3<=l) both fixed to halved per-codepoint bounds, matching the hell-family precedent -- without this, single-character surnames and any two-character full name were rejected as 'too short'. (4) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed at 11 call sites (kungfu/skill/*.lpc suck/tan/zhua/hua/huolang files, clone/user/user.lpc, d/city/npc/guidao.lpc, cmds/std/ansuan.lpc, cmds/std/surrender.lpc). (5) versiond.lpc (2194 lines, a much larger/fuller build-and-sync version daemon than zjdy2008wzb's, though the same socket-daemon class of bug) is reachable via logind.lpc's direct, unguarded VERSION_D->is_version_ok()/query_temp() calls in logon() on every connection even though it's not in adm/etc/preload -- gutted all real socket_*() call sites across in_server(), connect_server(), clear_syn_info() (socket_close loop only), send_command(), send_client_pending_msg(), syn_finish() (socket_close only), in_listen_callback(), in_write_callback(), in_close_callback(), cmd_close(), send_pending_msg(), send_result(), remove_connection() (socket_close only) per AGENTS.md §7.52; verified zero raw socket_*() efun calls remain and brace balance holds (145==145). adm/daemons/ftpd.lpc (117 socket calls) and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc (5 socket calls) are both dormant (commented out of adm/etc/preload, only guarded wizard-command callers) and were left untouched, matching AGENTS.md §7.52 guidance. Also confirmed already-correct pre-existing fixes carried from the shared hell source: securityd.lpc's save_object valid_write() check already compares against query_save_file()+__SAVE_EXTENSION__, and SECURITY_D/preload paths were already correct with adm/daemons/securityd first in the list. log/nosave/ directory was already present (unlike zjdy2008wzb, this archive did not hit the boot-blocking missing-directory bug). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (alongside the archive's pre-existing 'doing (admin)' entry). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (English id -> y confirm -> Chinese surname -> Chinese given name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> character-type menu (1-5, used 5) -> gender -> enters 世外桃源), admin permission confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. This lib's prompt shows a live clock (matches AGENTS.md §8.3 item 1) -- --idle 1.0 worked fine here, unlike zjdy2008wzb which needed 0.3. A pre-existing, non-fatal 'Bad argument 4 to EFUN message()' runtime error fires repeatedly during preload and during quit (simul_efun.lpc message() called with an int(0) 4th argument from several daemons' create()/sys_info() paths via channeld.lpc) -- does not block boot, registration, or admin verification; left as a pre-existing driver-message()-signature quirk, not part of this WASM pass's scope. LPC formatter run across all 7080 .lpc files (7025 written, 27 pre-existing errors, 28 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits.
